build.summary: Only creates /workspace and sets WORKDIR; tagged stepfun37-workspace:latest, then docker save | ssh docker load to the worker

speculative: MTP, 3 speculative tokens, using BF16 MTP weights grafted from stepfun-ai/Step-3.7-Flash (must be divisible by n_predict=3)

measured.concurrency_notes: Only a single-stream range is given; no concurrency numbers.
measured.source_line: With MTP `3`, observed throughput is approximately **31–32 tok/s**.

extra_setup: cp config.env.example config.env and set HEAD_IP/WORKER_IP (example link-local 169.254.x), ETH_IF, IB_IF. build-image.sh, copy-image-to-worker.sh, download-model.sh (huggingface-cli download on both nodes), then graft-mtp.sh, which runs lib/graft_mtp.py in the image on both nodes: it downloads the MTP shard(s) from stepfun-ai/Step-3.7-Flash (BF16), writes model-mtp.safetensors into the NVFP4 snapshot, updates the index, and extends the per-layer config lists. Containers start with --entrypoint= and 'sleep infinity'; the generated launch script is docker cp'd to /workspace/launch.sh and run with docker exec -d (worker first, head 5 s later). Passwordless SSH head->worker.
notes: Launch script first repoints the pip libnccl.so.2 to the system /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libnccl.so.2 (backup .spark-vllm-backup). It also patches vllm/model_executor/models/step3p5_mtp.py to 'quant_config = None' (marker local_mtp_unquant_hack) so the BF16 drafter is not packed as NVFP4. Worker gets --headless. decode_tps 31.5 is the midpoint of the stated 31-32 range. Image is built locally from vllm/vllm-openai:stepfun37 (a special StepFun tag); other images give BOS loops or garbage. The checkpoint config is multimodal (text_config), but the repo documents text use only. No Ray.
